subject: Initial call recap: SupportStack — PII gating, retention, and audit log needs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya@supportstack.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel@supportstack.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial call recap: SupportStack — PII gating, retention, and audit log needs

Hi Maya / Daniel — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard, success criteria, and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Key pain points (as discussed)
- Ingested customer messages frequently include direct identifiers (email, phone) and occasionally sensitive identifiers (SSNs for a small subset of enterprise flows).
- Current in-house NLU pipeline stores full request payloads in Postgres for troubleshooting; this is a blocker for compliance and key reason you’re exploring gating.
- Need to preserve ability to search/analyze trends while ensuring PII is not queryable or retained longer than policy allows.

Current stack notes you shared
- UI + API front-end (AWS ALB) -> ingestion service -> Postgres (raw payloads) + Redis (session cache).
- On-premises ETL for long-term archival; security team requires vendor controls (SOC2) and audit evidence.

Success criteria for a pilot
1) Ingress redaction/tokenization before anything leaves SupportStack network (or VPC option).
2) Per-customer retention controls: default raw payload retention = 30 days; searchable anonymized artifacts retained up to 12 months.
3) Full audit trail for every request (who, when, model variant) with exportable logs for audits.
4) Ability to run a redaction verification report on sample payloads during pilot.

What Redwood can provide (quick list)
- Ingress redaction SDK + proxy patterns (optional VPC deployment) and KMS-backed encryption for ephemeral keys.
- Configurable retention windows per-tenant and automatic redaction/garbage collection.
- Request-level audit logs with immutable storage and export (CSV/JSON) for auditors.
- SOC2 documentation and an optional confined demo instance for the first 30 days.

Next steps
- I’ll send our security one-pager (attached) and a short proposal outline with timelines.
- Can we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with your infra/security engineer (Daniel) and our infra lead (Karthik)? Suggested windows: Wed 10/21 10–12 PT or Thu 10/22 14–16 PT.
- Please confirm the sample payload you can share (PII redacted or test data) and the specific fields you consider sensitive.

Attachments: redwood-security-onepager.pdf

Thanks — I’ll coordinate next steps once you confirm availability.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform for LLMs
From: Maya Thompson <maya@supportstack.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel@supportstack.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial call recap: SupportStack — PII gating, retention, and audit log needs

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear summary. Couple clarifications from our side: 
- We confirmed with security: raw payload retention target is 30 days for full payloads, but we’d like anonymized / tokenized traces to be searchable for up to 90 days (not 12 months) during the pilot — we can re-evaluate for production.
- Sensitive fields: email, phone, name, account_id, and on rare cases SSN. We have legal-approved masking policy for SSN (redact on ingestion, never stored).
- We prefer the VPC/private deployment for the pilot if possible — our compliance team is reluctant to allow raw customer payloads to go to a multi-tenant hosted plane, even if redacted.

Daniel (copied) will own the technical deep-dive. Daniel — I can do Wed 10/21 10–11 PT. If that works for your side, please confirm and Rishi / Karthik can send the invite.

We’ll prepare a sample payload (sanitized) and the list of fields considered PII by Tuesday EOD. Also, if you have a short note on how you validate redaction (hashing vs deterministic tokenization vs full redaction), please include that in the follow-up.

Thanks,
Maya Thompson
Head of Security & Compliance, SupportStack
maya@supportstack.com

Folks — internal summary and action items after the discovery with SupportStack. Threading this here so we have a single source of truth.

What they need:
- VPC deployment option for pilot (they will not send raw payloads to multi-tenant hosted plane).
- Ingress-side redaction with configurable tokenization/hashing; legal requires that SSNs never be stored.
- Per-tenant retention controls: pilot = raw 30d / anonymized 90d.
- Request-level audit logs that are exportable and immutable.

Action items (owners)
- Karthik: prepare a short technical playbook (2–3 slides) showing VPC deployment options + KMS integration and expected effort. Due EOD Tue 10/20.
- Monica: draft the one-page pilot SOW + propose pricing tier for VPC pilot (include dev effort for redaction SDK integration). Attachments: proposal-outline.md (strawman). Due Wed 10/21.
- Rishi: schedule tech deep-dive for Wed 10/21 10–11 PT (tentative) and request sanitized sample payload & sensitive-field list from Maya.

Risks to call out to Sales Ops/Legal: additional infra effort for isolated VPC + potential SOC2 evidence gating will push pilot kickoff by ~2–3 weeks compared to hosted quickstart.

I’ll attach the one-pager and the strawman proposal; Monica, flag anything you want changed.

Attachments: proposal-outline.md

Thanks,
Rishi

Hi Maya / Daniel — looping you in with a concise pilot plan and next steps.

Pilot plan (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (prep): access & NDA (attached MA/NDA draft), share sanitized sample payloads and sensitive-field list (SupportStack).
- Week 1: VPC provisioning + KMS key exchange; deploy ingress redaction proxy (deterministic tokenization for email/account_id, one-way hashing for SSN).
- Week 2: Integration support + verify redaction reports on 500 sample messages.
- Week 3–4: Audit log verification, performance tuning, and handoff to SupportStack SRE.

Deliverables
- Redaction verification report (PDF/CSV)
- Exportable audit logs (JSON) with request-level metadata
- Pilot SOW and cost estimate

Open items for SupportStack
- Confirm the sanitized sample payload and HIPAA/SOC2 requirements (if any) via the HubSpot ticket below.
- Confirm whether deterministic tokenization vs hash aligns with legal — we will implement whichever provides the required reversibility/irreversibility.
